CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2841 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 11e8075d7975f34ab4baa8f2eb84220223443552. Bus nonce: 57fc2f09f6dd5e6a333bf8c0c60e1ca4. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 11e8075d7975f34ab4baa8f2eb84220223443552`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 11e8075d7975f34ab4baa8f2eb84220223443552` or `Fix review: blocked 11e8075d7975f34ab4baa8f2eb84220223443552 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 57fc2f09f6dd5e6a333bf8c0c60e1ca4`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `11e8075d7975f34ab4baa8f2eb84220223443552` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2841 11e8075d7975f34ab4baa8f2eb84220223443552") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2841-57fc2f09`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
DELTA REVIEW of #2841 (topic r10-card-voice, R10-CARD-VOICE), head 11e8075d7975f34ab4baa8f2eb84220223443552 (handoff 59c744f4), bus nonce 57fc2f09f6dd5e6a333bf8c0c60e1ca4. Review per dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md (origin/main) from a detached worktree at the head SHA, using the FINDER's harness: the study's harness (6aea0d10 harness.html and states.js) and the finder's tests/card_browser.mjs P9 grid, which the prior verdict ran at both ends. Not the fixer's driver alone: the fixer's driver dev/audit/harnesses/r10_card_harmony.mjs may be run too, but the browser grid is the proof.

PRIOR VERDICT: blocked at 2cfb8b9660f5940d27a8ed38c5c54e77e9a821e3 (probe/verdict review/2841): regression, tests / browser red at that head and green at the merge base. Reproduced by HPO_BROWSER_SCOPE=full node tests/card_browser.mjs after tests/plan_view.py: head rc=1, base rc=0. Two failures: (1) "P9 grid: every cell mounted and every driver step found its target": threw 29, page.screenshot "Clipped area is either empty or outside the resulting image"; (2) "P9 grid: no pop-up leaves the viewport or its chart": div.slot-menu 6.7px, div.tooltip 4.5px, div.slot-menu 5.3px outside (10 in all). The likeliest cause named: the dialog's 14 px floor (H1) enlarging the slot menu and tooltip. The body's Red checks did not name tests / browser and the scoped gate skipped the browser lane (the cheaper detector before the handoff). The code verdicts on C1 to C6 are settled unless the delta touches them.

CHECK, the delta since 2cfb8b96 (git diff 2cfb8b96..head):
1. The P9 grid at the head: run HPO_BROWSER_SCOPE=full node tests/card_browser.mjs after tests/plan_view.py at the head and at the merge base; print rc and the PASS/FAIL lines of both. Both failures must be gone: 0 cells threw, 0 pop-ups outside; the head's "N text runs, M inked pairs" is printed. Null control: reintroduce the overflow (revert the fix hunk on a scratch copy) and show the grid goes red again, so the fix, not the harness, turned it green.
2. The 14 px floor and caption roles (C1) are not weakened to pass the grid: re-measure the study's figures (dialog base 14/14/14 px, HTML text nodes under 12 px = 0 on every page and width, wi-hint 12.00, group title 12.60); name any carry whose measured value moved from the prior verdict.
3. tests / browser is green at the head from the check-runs API; the body's ## Red checks names tests / browser (and the root-cause or the cheaper detector, per defect-root-cause.md: a red check a cheaper detector could have run owes an answer; the browser lane's local cost is about 4 minutes). Every other red at the head is named and answered in the body.
4. The merge with origin/main: git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main head exits 0; claim files byte-identical to origin/main unless the body claims drift for a card fixture, and then every claim carries its direction and claims-for equal to VERSION; VERSION, manifest and RELEASE_NOTES untouched; dev/programme/delivery/2841.md is in the three-dot diff.
5. Carries (R10-CARD-VOICE, 6, below) were answered at round 1; re-open one only if the delta changes its answer. python3 -I tools/audit/carry_audit.py pr 2841 must print 0 unrouted.

ROSTER CARRIES FOR R10-CARD-VOICE (6, from the live roster):
CARRY 1: H1, the dialog type floor, from the harmony study (probe/card-harmony-design at 6aea0d10b8f2e618d64c684755db9aaa0c624588; its HARMONY.md and four before/after pages live under docs/design/harmony in that ref; read them from the ref, never from memory). Measured: the enlarged dialog's base is 12.0 / 12.0 / 12.9 px at 375 / 768 / 1280 against the card's own 14 px, so its chrome and captions render smaller than the tile's — what-if hints 10.2, group titles 10.8, the wide legend note 9.1-9.8. The fix: DIALOG_FONT_PX_MIN from 12 to 14, and font-size max(12px, <em>) on the caption roles. Control: measure with the study's harness in the ref (its harness/states.js, page and theme query parameters) at all three widths; the card face is the null arm and must move only in the caption roles. Re-measure at the merge base; the px figures here describe the study's tree, not the fix's.
CARRY 2: H2, the setup page's controls and the Badge. Measured: the dialog's shared rule raises .chip to 1 em but not the layout bar button it also names, so the bar renders 9.8 px beside a 12 px chip. Carry the chip's two dialog lines to the bar button, and land the owner's chosen Badge (probe/card-symbols-design at 2cc4d5ebc89657e4103c09447fc2d0e4c7adfe40) with the reconciliation the harmony study owes: glyph stroke 1.5 units (the card's icon and pipe tier, not 1.6), the Configure page-name line 11 units, the disc 18 units rendered at 14.0 / 17.5 / 29.8 px across the three widths, and aria-hidden on the disc because the box's accessible name already carries its type and coil state. Control: the bar's rendered font-size equals the chip's at all three widths, and the disc's px is measured rather than assumed; the box outline and pipe tiers are the null arm that must not change.
CARRY 3: H3, all three arms; the owner took the unthemed dark arm as in scope (tvofi, 2026-10-20). (a) The health and advisor rows take the pair's own surface variable with the card's literal as its fallback: measured 1.20:1 in the arm where the theme does not define the variable, against 11.08:1 on the card's surface-2 token. (b) The health headings drop from 700, the card's only bold weight, to 600. (c) The savings empty state becomes the same empty shape the other three empty states use. Control: the unthemed dark arm is the measurement and a stock dark theme is the null arm, where the row already reads correctly and the change is a no-op; state both in the body.
CARRY 4: H4. The savings replay panel is the one drawing with neither the 8 px axis floor nor a phone min-width, so its labels render 6.2-6.8 px at 375. Give it the setup map's already-shipped treatment inside the <=600 px media query: overflow-x auto on the panel and a 560 px min-width on its svg. Measured effect: labels 10.3-11.2 px at 375, with 768 and 1280 unchanged. Control: the label px at 375 before and after, and the setup map as the shipped precedent for the same tradeoff (a sideways scroll at phone width).
CARRY 5: The study's three one-line corrections, in this pull request. (1) RECEIPT_CSS carries three var(--hpo-text-sm, 14px) fallbacks against a 13 px token — make the fallback agree with the token. (2) The setup chip comment claims the drawn control wears a legend chip's label size, which is false by width (8.6-18.2 px against 12-12.9) — correct the comment, since this study does not change that drawing. (3) DIALOG_FONT_PX_MAX at 21 is unreachable because the dialog's width caps at 1700 px and the ratio yields 17.85 px — lower it to 18 or record it as aspirational. Each corrected claim is anchored to the symbol it describes, never to a line number.
CARRY 6: The study derives 23 views and finds that card_drift.mjs's 40 states pin 18 of them, leaving the Savings page and its empty state, the Health page, the setup not-published state and the advisor empty state with no drift state. Add drift states for those five views in this pull request, or record in the body why a view cannot be pinned; a re-recorded or extended state set carries its reason, and a view left unpinned is named rather than silently absent.

Output: write verdict.md in a fresh directory of your own. Its first line is exactly "Fix review: merge 11e8075d7975f34ab4baa8f2eb84220223443552" or "Fix review: blocked 11e8075d7975f34ab4baa8f2eb84220223443552 <class>: <reason>" (no brackets; class lower-case letters and dashes). Then a blank line, then "bus-nonce: 57fc2f09f6dd5e6a333bf8c0c60e1ca4". Then the body in sections: a blocked verdict's block under "## Block"; each finding this PR does not settle is its own bullet under "## Findings" ending in "Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>". Everything else under "## Evidence", with files under ev/, one of them holding the full 40-hex head. Return the verdict on a probe ref: the commit is built with a private index as the role file gives, then pushed to refs/heads/probe/rev-2841-57fc2f09. Do NOT run bus.sh. Do not post comments, approve or merge. Re-read the head with git ls-remote before writing the verdict. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit or comment. Do not name any path under a home directory in the verdict.
